Comprehension:

Directions: Study the following information carefully and answer the questions given below. In a certain code,

"check list has been generated" is written as"jo ke al si ha",

"His idea has check" is written as "of al fu ha",

"number in check list" is written as "ha ya go ke".

"His number generated there" is written as "ya si fu xo"

Which of the following may represents 'My number has been generated'?
solution: **Given:** "check list has been generated" is written as"jo ke al si ha", "His idea has check" is written as "of al fu ha", "number in check list" is written as "ha ya go ke". "His number generated there" is written as "ya si fu xo"
